barrier: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite sheet for BARCODE System Override, a side-scrolling hand-inked cyberpunk game. Create ONE reusable barrier hardware kit atlas, a precise 3-column by 2-row equal-cell grid on a truly transparent background, no checkerboard, no labels, no scene. Canvas 1536x1024, each cell 512x512. Top row: same tall facade-mounted hologram emitter in three states (off, energized, powered-down scorched). Bottom row: same low pavement emitter in three corresponding states. Each top-row object occupies centered x=160..352 y=50..462 in its own cell: narrow heavy dark gunmetal mounting rail, bolted flanges, bundled conduit, angular protective shoulders, several lime-white vertical emitter lenses. Bottom-row objects centered in their own cells x=70..442 y=170..390: squat solid 3D curb machinery with visible top and right-hand side, perspective back edge rising slightly to the right, feet bolted to pavement, vent slots, lime-white slit lens. Both hardware types share design language. Make usable isolated whole sprites, all margins transparent, identical location and silhouette between state variants. Thick irregular black ink contours, graphic-novel hand-painted steel, scratched desaturated blue-gray metal, subtle purple bounce light, controlled lime optics, strong small-scale readability. No huge holographic field, no letters, no text, no characters, no background, no floating spark cloud. Actual detailed machinery asset art, not UI icons or mockup panels.
drone: Use case: stylized-concept. Production animation atlas for a NEW rooftop security drone enemy in BARCODE System Override, side-scrolling cyberpunk graphic-novel action game. One 4-column 2-row sprite sheet, exactly eight equal cells, 1536x768 image, each cell 384x384. Truly transparent background. Each drone centered at local (192,192), all within 30px margins, no shadows/background/grid/text. SAME compact drone silhouette, proportions, lighting, camera and scale in all eight cells: a squat angular steel hovering body, two armored downward thruster nacelles, ONE large amber camera eye in a right-facing sensor head, small underbody pulse emitter, a battered aerial fin. Side-on three-quarter view facing RIGHT in every frame. Recognizably mechanical, NOT a car, NOT a humanoid, NOT a flying virus, no wings or rotors. Eight complete-body drawings ordered left-to-right top-to-bottom: 0 neutral patrol thrusters short; 1 patrol thrusters medium; 2 patrol thrusters long; 3 patrol thrusters medium; 4 warning with amber eye aperture open and pulse emitter gathering a small amber light; 5 charged warning eye bright and emitter unfolded; 6 discharge with SHORT lime-white muzzle flare directed right, body recoil by only a few pixels; 7 damaged with cracked eye housing and small sparks but complete silhouette. Do not vary body position during patrol; animate engine light and small fins only. Rough thick black ink outlines, hand-painted chipped blue-gray gunmetal plates, lavender reflected highlights, black recesses, amber eye hostile identity, lime-white thrusters; match a detailed hand-drawn cyberpunk city with charcoal buildings and neon cyan/purple windows. Strong silhouette readable at 110px on screen. No labels or letters, no environmental scenery, no white/black backdrop or checkerboard. Sprite production art, not a concept poster.
processing: Preserved whole sprites and generated alpha. Cropped observed hardware rows with one shared scale per type. Normalized drone 4x2 grid to 256px cells.
